Footer.tagline: Free bilingual QR utility for turning links into codes and codes back into links.

Home.badge: Fast QR tools for modern teams
Home.title: Turn links into QR codes, or read QR codes back into links.
Home.description: Scanme keeps QR workflows simple: generate from a URL, decode from an uploaded image, or scan in real time from your camera with a calm minimalist interface.

generate.title: Link to QR
generate.text: Generate a clean QR from any valid HTTP or HTTPS link.

decode.title: Image to link
decode.text: Upload an image and decode the QR content in the browser.

scan.title: Camera scan
scan.text: Use your device camera to read QR codes in real time.

download.title: PNG and SVG
download.text: Download generated QR codes in practical formats for web or print.

steps.one: Paste a valid link to create a QR, or upload a QR image to decode it.
steps.two: Switch to camera mode when you want live scanning on desktop or mobile.
steps.three: Copy the result, open the link, or download the generated code as PNG or SVG.

ToolPage.title: Everything you need for a lightweight QR workflow.

Faq.title: Everything important, without the clutter.
Faq.description: A lightweight FAQ for the core behavior of the MVP.

free.question: Is Scanme free?
free.answer: Yes. This MVP focuses on free core QR generation and decoding features.

privacy.question: Are uploaded images stored?
privacy.answer: No storage flow is built into this MVP. Uploaded image decoding happens in the browser.

mobile.question: Does it work on mobile?
mobile.answer: Yes. The interface is responsive and the camera scanner is intended for both mobile and desktop browsers.

formats.question: Which formats can I download?
formats.answer: Generated QR codes can be downloaded as PNG or SVG.

About.title: A small utility product with a focused interface.
About.description: Scanme is designed for quick QR tasks without visual noise, account friction, or unnecessary complexity.

body.one: The product is intentionally narrow in scope: generate a QR from a link, decode a QR from an image, and scan a QR from a camera feed.
body.two: The design direction favors calm spacing, restrained color, and clear actions so the tool stays useful on both desktop and mobile.
